From А́ред (Áred), variant of Иа́ред (Iáred, “Jared (Old Testament patriarch who lived 962 years)”), from Ancient Greek Ἰάρετ (Iáret), from Biblical Hebrew יָרֶד (yā́reḏ), pausal form of יֶרֶד (yéreḏ).

ety.text: Inherited from Old East Slavic государь (gosudarĭ), a later form of господарь (gospodarĭ). The reshaping of the latter has been explained by the influence of the root суд- (sud-, “to judge”) or by a relaxed pronunciation.
